entities.name: Dev
entities.rationale: Developer pushing source code changes to CodeCommit.

entities.name: CODECOMMIT
entities.rationale: AWS CodeCommit source control repository storing application code.

entities.name: CODEBUILD
entities.rationale: AWS CodeBuild compiling source code, building container images, and triggering deployment.

entities.name: REGISTRY
entities.rationale: Amazon ECR (Container Registry) storing built container images.

entities.name: CLOUDFORMATION
entities.rationale: AWS CloudFormation provisioning infrastructure using ChangeSets to deploy into the VPC.

entities.name: VPC
entities.rationale: Virtual Private Cloud container boundary enclosing target components (ECS, IAM, ALB).

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Amazon ECS cluster component running containerized applications inside the VPC.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: AWS Identity and Access Management managing security roles inside the VPC boundary.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Application Load Balancer component distributing incoming traffic inside the VPC.

entities.name: CODEPIPELINE
entities.rationale: Ícono de AWS CodePipeline ubicado en la pizarra de forma aislada sin conexiones explícitas.

visual_connections.description: Developer pushes source code commits to AWS CodeCommit.
CodeBuild pushes compiled container images to Amazon ECR (REGISTRY).
CodeBuild passes build artifacts/ChangeSets to AWS CloudFormation.
CloudFormation deploys and updates infrastructure components inside the VPC.
